### Organization Policy Documents
[DOC901] Export Formats and Link Expiry (Data Analytics)
Reports export in CSV and JSON formats. Asynchronous export links expire after 24 hours and can be downloaded from the Reports tab.

### Reference Replies (Tone Only — Do Not Override Policy Rules)
Example 1 (Technical Support | medium):
Thank you for contacting us, <name>. We will check your export request and get back to you soon.

### Incoming Customer Email
Subject: Report export format and link

Hi, what formats can we export reports in, and how long does the download link stay active?

Thanks,
Sam

### Draft Reply
assistant: Hello Sam, thank you for reaching out. Reports can be exported in CSV and JSON formats, and asynchronous download links remain active for 24 hours inside the Reports tab [DOC901]. Please let us know if you need any further assistance.

### Organization Policy Documents
[DOC902] Annual Add-On Cancellation Policy (Billing and Payments)
Annual add-on modules are eligible for a full refund only within 7 calendar days of activation. Downgrades submitted after 7 days take effect at the next annual renewal without partial refunds. Planned weekend maintenance downtime is excluded from credit claims.

### Reference Replies (Tone Only — Do Not Override Policy Rules)
Example 1 (Billing and Payments | high):
Hello <name>, we are reviewing your refund request and will follow up shortly.

### Incoming Customer Email
Subject: Urgent refund for add-on activated 12 days ago

Hi Support, we activated an annual add-on 12 days ago and also noticed a brief planned weekend maintenance window. Can you issue a full refund and apply a maintenance credit immediately?

### Draft Reply
assistant: Hello <name>, we understand the urgency of your request and reviewed your account against our billing policy. Because the annual add-on was activated 12 days ago, it falls outside the 7 calendar day full-refund window; any downgrade will take effect at your next annual renewal without a partial refund [DOC902]. Additionally, planned weekend maintenance downtime is excluded from service credit claims [DOC902]. Please share your account reference if you would like us to schedule the downgrade for your upcoming renewal.
